meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进项目、注册到渠道入口、装好指定版本依赖，并跑构建与测试，让 NanoClaw 能通过电子邮件收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件渠道，或想让机器人用电子邮件和你对话时触发；账号、域名验证与 webhook 配置仍需你手动完成。

say.text: 帮我给项目接入 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建和测试。

say.text: 我的邮箱是 me@example.com，让 agent 用邮件回我。
say.note: 会把你注册为 owner 并发出问候邮件。
会检查 API key 与 .env 里的配置。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the Resend email adapter into the project, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned adapter package, and runs build and tests so NanoClaw can send and receive email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw or want the bot reachable by email; account, domain and webhook setup stays manual.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to my project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs build and tests.

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com — have my agent reply by email.
say_en.note: Registers you as owner and sends a hello email.

say_en.text: Resend sends fail with 401 — help me debug.
say_en.note: Checks the API key and .env values.
